verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. Both crop the skate illustration down to a sliver at the top edge, so the key image is lost. In both, the 'ICE RINK' headline is crammed against the divider bars, and the 'LINK IN BIO' button runs into 'RINK'. Decorative circles and the arrow crowd 'USE CODE' and 'XMASRINK'. All the copy is tiny, and there is wide dead space on the left and right of the banner.
